title: DVAC registers criminal case over alleged irregularities in the purchase of books
description: The criminal case has been registered against a Chennai-based publisher and “unidentified officials” of the Directorate of Public Libraries, Anna Centenary Library, Chennai, and Periyar Arivulagam, Coimbatore. On Monday (November 16, 2026), DVAC officials launched a search at seven places and seized receipt vouchers for book procurement and other documents. Mohan, proprietor of Akal Vizhakku Publishers, was arrested
